name: m4-lazydepth-paired-full

variantDescriptions.eager: lubDepth computed before solving and merging, as in base
variantDescriptions.lazy: lubDepth computed only when solve lubs/glbs two or more bounds, or mergePrefixAndArgs merges prefixes or arguments that differ

description: Lazy lub depth (retronym/scala#245) off vs on via the bench-only `-Ylazy-depth` flag (`claude/typeref-bench-lazydepth-flag`), alternating by iteration within each fork, in a full compile of the scala corpus. The typer-only paired run (m4-lazydepth-paired) measured -2.46%. 4 forks of 20 + 30 single shots, 8 GB G1, patched JDK 26, M4.
